This project involved designing and building a versatile indoor photoshoot stage for a small production space. I created a modular, durable platform that could work for portrait photography, product shoots, and small creative sets.

The build included:

-   Constructing a raised wooden stage with a smooth, stable surface capable of supporting lighting, props, and multiple subjects.

![single frame model](images/photoshoot_stage/Image%202025-10-08%20at%2018.34%20(1).JPG)

![overall design idea](images/photoshoot_stage/Screenshot%202025-10-08%20at%2019.29.00.PNG)

-   Custom trim and edging to create a clean visual boundary between the stage and surrounding studio space.

![modelled single frame with subfloor](images/photoshoot_stage/Image%202025-10-08%20at%2018.34.JPG)

![modelled single frame with step nosing](images/photoshoot_stage/Image%202025-10-08%20at%2018.32.JPG)

-   Optimizing lighting conditions, with the platform designed to bounce soft light and minimize unwanted shadows.

![finished frames](images/photoshoot_stage/IMG_2780.HEIC) ![frames with the subfloor](images/photoshoot_stage/IMG_2784.HEIC)

![hardwood flooring](images/photoshoot_stage/IMG_2790.HEIC) ![prepping the precise cuts](images/photoshoot_stage/IMG_2795.HEIC)

![precise cuts](images/photoshoot_stage/IMG_2800.HEIC) ![finished product](images/photoshoot_stage/IMG_2805.HEIC)

This was a full end-to-end build: design, materials sourcing, fabrication, assembly, and finishing. The final result is a bright, minimal, and highly functional stage that elevates the quality and flexibility of indoor studio shoots.
